greeting.text: Mara stands beside the mine map, one hand resting on a red-wax mark near the ice caves.

choices.text: What is happening at the old ice workings?
Remind me what you need from the ice workings.
The ice chamber has been surveyed.
I will leave you to the Lodge.

briefing.text: The old route opens into an ice chamber above the waterfall. We lost its current survey when the weather closed in, and I will not send another unprepared miner there. Reach the chamber, take its measure, and return alive. The mountain can keep the rest.

choices.text: I will survey the ice chamber.

in_progress.text: Follow the mountain route east from the old mine exit to the frozen waterfall. The chamber is beyond the ice cave. Do not mistake reaching it for surviving it.

resolved.text: A clear report is worth more than a brave lie. Frostpeak will mark the chamber accurately, and the next crew will know what the mountain is asking of them.
